Subject: Gravelin Plaza LLC - Referral Required

Hi Tomas,

Thanks for the submission on Gravelin Plaza LLC.

I need to refer this one to our senior underwriting team for consideration due to the following:

**Referral Items:**
- The location falls within 16 km of the coast
- Our existing coastal accumulation within 25 km is already high, so we need to evaluate our capacity carefully

Before I send this up, can you please provide:
- Exact distance from coast and elevation details
- Any wind mitigation features or recent roof updates
- Construction class and year built

Given the coastal exposure and our accumulation concerns, you may also want to consider reaching out to a specialty coastal market for competitive terms.

I'll circle back once I hear from leadership.

Best,
[Underwriter name]
